description: Metadata for the themes defined in tokens.css. Used by the showcase and by agents choosing a direction.

themes.name: Atelier
themes.description: Warm paper canvas with a whisper of grain, ink-dark text and a terracotta accent. Serif page titles give it a studio feel.
themes.signature: Paper-grain canvas + Fraunces page titles and numerals

themes.name: Linen
themes.description: Soft linen neutrals with a sage accent and rounder corners. Quiet and reassuring.
themes.signature: Generous radius and soft sage highlights

themes.name: Coastal
themes.description: Crisp whites, cool grey-blue neutrals and an ocean accent. The most universal of the six.

themes.name: Blush
themes.description: Rosy off-whites with a deep rose accent and an editorial serif for titles.
themes.signature: Instrument Serif titles, rounded soft cards

themes.name: Noir
themes.description: Near-black surfaces, champagne gold accent and a classic Garamond for titles. Sharp corners, low noise.
themes.signature: Gold on black, Garamond numerals, edge-lit surfaces

themes.name: Midnight
themes.description: Deep navy with a periwinkle accent and Geist throughout. Feels like a pro tool.
